name: Party Identification And Account 203
definition: Parties involved in the triparty collateral transaction.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for a party.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

PartyCapacity.name: Party Capacity
PartyCapacity.definition: Specifies the role of the party in the transaction.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.
